CommunityApplications.Profile:
Plugins by David Coulson for people running bigger Unraid servers.
- **Docker Search**: a live search box and quick filters (running, healthy, updates, autostart and more) at the top of the Docker tab. Works with folder.view2. - **Storage Topology**: read-only pages showing how your SAS storage and network hardware are wired and how healthy they are: controllers, cables, disk shelves, bays, NICs, transceivers, bonds and LLDP neighbours. - **LLDP for UNRAID**: runs lldpd so the server announces itself to your switches and shows which switch port each interface is plugged into. A maintained fork of desertwitch's plugin.
Support links are on each plugin's listing (an Unraid forum thread or the plugin's GitHub issues).
